summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Phase F3: TailAdmin two-step admin login (credentials + 6-box OTP) plus dashboard/logout/route-guard/landing/backend-health regression. Executed 14 Playwright scenarios covering every checklist item in the review request. All 14 PASSED (100%). The paste-full-6-digit flow triggers onComplete auto-submit which unmounts the OTP inputs mid-check; a follow-up run confirmed end-to-end that paste alone (no click on verify) lands on /admin/dashboard with the admin_access_token cookie set, greeting 'Welcome back, Adi Primanto', email 'admin@adiprimanto.com', permission count 128.
verified_scenarios: Login page renders with all data-testids (email, password, toggle, submit, step-credentials)
Client-side validation: malformed email surfaces login-email-error (backend 422 mapped)
Invalid credentials -> login-form-error 'These credentials do not match our records.' + toast-error + stays on step 1
Password visibility toggle switches input type password<->text
Step 1 happy path -> login-step-verification, toast-success, otp-masked-email='ad***@adiprimanto.com', 6 OTP boxes, 'Code expires in 9:59', '5 attempts left', resend disabled
OTP behaviour: auto-advance focus, Backspace moves focus back, verify button disabled until 6 digits entered
Wrong OTP 000000 -> otp-form-error 'The verification code is invalid.' + toast-error + attempts '5 attempts left' -> '4 attempts left'
Back button returns to step 1 with password field cleared
Step 2 END-TO-END: real OTP read from laravel.log, paste into box 0 fills all 6 and auto-submits (no verify click needed), lands on /admin/dashboard with cookie, greeting/email/perms all correct
Logout clears admin_access_token cookie, shows toast, redirects to /admin/login; subsequent /admin/dashboard visit re-redirects to /admin/login
Landing page (/) still renders (title + hero content intact)
Backend regression: GET /api/v1/health returns healthy JSON envelope
critical_code_review_comments: Non-httpOnly admin_access_token cookie is intentional (needed by Next.js middleware) and documented, but keep in mind XSS mitigation: strict CSP, sanitize any user-authored HTML fields before rendering. This is a known trade-off, not a defect.

OTP paste handler correctly consumes clipboard text via ClipboardEvent dispatch and auto-submits through onComplete; consider adding an aria-live region for the countdown and attempts-left so screen readers announce them.
login attempt rate limit (5/min) is enforced server-side; UI could surface a specific error string when the limiter hits to distinguish from bad credentials.
test_credentials: admin@adiprimanto.com / AdiPrimanto#2026 (super admin, 128 perms), editor.test@adiprimanto.com / EditorTest#2026 (used for wrong-password test; failed_login_attempts and locked_until reset via tinker after test)
seed_data_creation: None. Only ran php artisan cache:clear between login bursts to reset rate limiter and reset editor.test failed_login_attempts=0/locked_until=null after wrong-password test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase F3 admin login UI is fully green. When testing anything that repeatedly hits POST /api/v1/auth/login, run 'cd /app/backend && php artisan cache:clear' between bursts (throttle is 5 req/min per email+IP). Use editor.test for any bad-password test and reset via User::update(failed_login_attempts=0, locked_until=null) afterwards. OTP is written to /app/backend/storage/logs/laravel.log by the laravel-queue worker; allow ~2s after step 1. The full-string paste into otp-digit-0 auto-submits and unmounts the inputs, so don't try to read input_value after paste.
rca of the issue: No unresolved issue. First run's test #11 initially showed as FAIL because the assertion script tried to read input values of the OTP boxes AFTER paste, but the onComplete auto-submit had already navigated to /admin/dashboard and unmounted them. The follow-up isolated run confirmed the paste + auto-submit flow works end-to-end (cookie set, dashboard reached, all dashboard testids correct).
